Model extraction 
Published B/PB/QB/EE, landings and balanced diet agree with the canonical inputs. 
Printed diet column sums 0.999–1.001 are normalized by their actual sums. The paper 
specifies zero biomass accumulation; this replaces missing BA formerly solved as a 
balance residual. GS is unreported; the calculator uses 0.2 for consumers.

Geographic fit 
A. Region covered by study: approximately 0.65–0.69%. 
B. Study area covered by region: approximately 95–100%. 
Temporal fit 
Model baseline 1999–2001 is transferred over catch 1950–2019, including the 2019 
reference. Fixed model coefficients and assumed category weights do not reconstruct 
changing annual ecosystems. Regional lineage weights use identified total catch 1950–
2019, then transfer across individual years and bases. 
Other 
With source-stated zero BA, the rounded model remains unbalanced: maximum relative 
production residual 5.35%. TE also has a 3.81% primary-production closure gap and a 
near-singular marine-mammal group(ID 1). Nonnegative SPPR does not remove these 
limitations.

Taxon mapping and coverage 
Reference: 2019 landings; all 430 catch labels, including zero catches. Independent all-taxon simple-chain PPR; no 
group filter. 
24 source groups plus one synthetic import; 430 catch taxa. 
Simple-chain PPR totals 514,724,666.461 t C in 2019. 
37 taxa lack a saved TL/coefficient. All have zero 2019 landings and contribute zero annual PPR; no positive-catch 
contribution is unknown. 
Simple-chain PPR uses the independent simple trophic chain method.
